title: Bear With Me: The Pizza Chronicles (Prequel)
description:
A scream. A forest. One very angry bear. What could possibly go wrong?

You and your best friend are taking a peaceful walk through the woods when a scream cuts through the trees. You rush to help — and come face to face with a furious bear. From this single moment, every decision is yours… and almost all of them end badly.

Bear With Me is a short, fully voice-acted dark-comedy visual novel built entirely around choice and consequence. Run away and live with the guilt. Throw a rock (at the bear, or… your friend). Call the Hero Association, the army, Animal Control, your mom, the Ghostbusters — or just order a pizza. Each path spirals into its own ridiculous, often gruesome, always funny conclusion.

But survive enough timelines and you'll start to remember. And only then can you finally answer the one question that started it all: who actually screamed?

FEATURES

• 🐻 14 unique endings — from "Bear Food" to "Death by Paperwork" to "Died for the Gram," plus one hidden TRUE ending you unlock only after finding all the others.

• 🎭 Choices that matter — a single branch explodes into wildly different stories. There's no right answer, only your answer.

• 🎙️ Fully voice-acted — every line, every character, every absurd death, performed by a full voice cast.

• 🌀 Meta time-loop twist — your "deaths" aren't the end. They're how you learn to read the forest.

• 🍕 Pitch-black comedy — bureaucratic nightmares, drone-delivered pizza, viral selfies, and a bear with surprisingly good comedic timing.

• 🔁 Short and endlessly replayable — perfect for one sitting, made to be replayed until the gallery is complete.

How many ways can one walk in the woods go wrong? Find out.
description_short: You and your friend hear a scream in the woods, run toward it, and meet a very angry bear. One choice decides everything. Will you run, panic, throw a rock, or order pizza? Discover all 14 endings in this fully voice-acted dark comedy.
